purpose: Measure whether RateMyHarness is selected for concrete Agent runtime and harness audits without absorbing Agent Skill review, product review, ordinary code work, test harnesses, prompts, tools, or general architecture advice.
selection_rule: a concrete Agent harness, runtime, orchestrator, configuration, trace set, or current workspace plus rating, audit, red-team, operations, release, re-review, or artifact-grounded defense intent

cases.prompt: 给当前仓库里的 Agent harness 打个分，看看这个 runtime 能不能上线。
As a Staff runtime engineer, run a strict team-shared audit of ./runtime/agent-harness. Inspect its loop, tool dispatch, state, retries, and termination.
Red-team the coding-agent harness in this workspace for privileged production. Check whether untrusted tool output can gain authority or bypass approvals.
Act as the SRE operator for this production Agent runtime. Audit cancellation, timeouts, retry storms, budgets, backpressure, and recovery from the supplied configs and traces.
As the harness owner, review this local prototype and tell me whether it actually improves task success enough to justify its latency, cost, and user friction.
I fixed H-001 through H-004 in the Agent harness. Re-run the same role, target, traces, failure injections, rubric, and acceptance tests, then show the score delta.
Would you approve this orchestration runtime for public use? Audit https://github.com/example/agent-runner and give me a release gate, not implementation advice.
Make me defend the Agent runtime in this workspace one question at a time. Derive questions from its loop, permissions, memory, and traces, then score the harness and my understanding separately.
用红队视角做 privileged-production 审查：这个外层 runtime 会不会把工具返回值当成系统指令，或者把一个用户的 memory 带进另一个会话？
Review the run traces and configuration for this high-volume agent service as an SRE. Decide whether cancellation, queue pressure, retry behavior, and incident diagnosis are production-ready.
给 ./skills/db-migrator 这个 Agent Skill 做严格评分。
cases.reason: the artifact is an Agent Skill and belongs to RateMySkill

cases.prompt: Audit my vibe-coded checkout SaaS and tell me whether it can accept real payments.
Explain the difference between an agent loop and an agent harness.
cases.reason: general teaching without a concrete harness artifact or audit intent

cases.prompt: Build me a Python agent harness with tools, memory, retries, and tracing.
cases.reason: implementation request rather than evaluation of an existing harness

cases.prompt: This retry helper sometimes raises TimeoutError. Debug the function and patch it.
Review my pytest test harness for flaky browser tests.
cases.reason: software test harness rather than an Agent runtime harness

cases.prompt: Security-audit this standalone MCP server and its tool implementations.
cases.reason: the target is an MCP service rather than the runtime that governs an Agent loop

cases.prompt: Rate this single customer-support agent response for correctness and tone.
cases.reason: output evaluation without a runtime artifact

cases.prompt: Should I use LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or a custom loop for a new project?
cases.reason: framework selection and architecture advice without an existing artifact to audit

cases.prompt: Review this system prompt and JSON tool schema for clarity, but do not inspect the runtime.
cases.reason: prompt and schema review explicitly excludes the harness
